scripts.build: cd packages/web && bun x vite build
scripts.dev: sh -c "(cd packages/server && bun run dev) & (cd packages/web && bun run dev) & wait"
scripts.test: bun test packages/shared packages/server packages/web packages/cli packages/native/test
scripts.typecheck: bun x tsc --noEmit -p packages/shared/tsconfig.json && bun x tsc --noEmit -p packages/server/tsconfig.json && bun x tsc --noEmit -p packages/web/tsconfig.json && bun x tsc --noEmit -p packages/cli/tsconfig.json && bun run --cwd packages/native typecheck
